    L0.3 — tracial von Neumann ultrapower R^ω + GNS (CEP critical-path substrate) #

    The critical-path substrate: GNS for a tracial state, the hyperfinite II₁ factor package, the tracial matrix ultrapower via a nonprincipal ultrafilter germ, and the discharge target connesEmbeddable_of_amenable_through_germ (amenable trace ⇒ Connes-embeddable, the Basic.lean summit). The hard descent — the C*/W*-structure + ultralimit trace on the germ carrier (ℓ∞(M_{d(n)}) / {‖·‖₂ → 0}) — is the single hardest substrate brick, kept as honest sorry.
